description: Official BetAnsells Terms & Conditions, Rules and Payout Limits (effective 27th Nov 2025)

STATE_FORECAST_NON_EXISTENT_RUNNER.description: Settlement: a single forecast containing a non-runner or a racecard number not on the card is settled as a single. At entry the bet goes on as written (user, 23 Oct): a card number that isn't in the race is entered as a void selection ('v'), and Betty settles the non-runner.

STATE_FORECAST_DIFFERENT_RACES.description: Forecast selections running in different races split into two half-stake Win Singles.

STATE_FORECAST_REPEATED_RUNNER.description: Repeated selection in a forecast converts to a Win Single at full forecast stake.

STATE_FORECAST_LONE_SELECTION.description: Lone selection in a forecast converts to a Win Single at full forecast stake.

STATE_FORECAST_UNNAMED_FAVOURITE.description: Unnamed favourites cannot be used in forecasts (void).

STATE_TRICAST_ONE_NON_RUNNER.description: Settlement: a tricast with a non-runner (or a number not on the card) is settled as a straight forecast on the remaining selections in the order written; a full-cover combination as a reverse forecast on the remaining two. At entry the bet goes on as written (user, 23 Oct): a card number that isn't in the race is entered as a void selection ('v'), and Betty settles the non-runner.

STATE_TRICAST_TWO_NON_RUNNERS.description: Settlement: a tricast with 2 non-runners (or numbers not on the card) is settled as a win single at SP on the remaining runner. At entry the bet goes on as written (user, 23 Oct): a card number that isn't in the race is entered as a void selection ('v'), and Betty settles the non-runner.

STATE_TRICAST_REPEATED_RUNNER.description: Repeated selection in a tricast converts to a Straight Forecast on the distinct selections.

STATE_TRICAST_UNNAMED_FAVOURITE.description: Unnamed favourites cannot be used in tricasts (void).

STATE_FAVOURITE_EACH_WAY_REQUESTED.description: Starting price bets on favourites in horse and dog racing are Win Only; Each-Way place part is void.

STATE_MULTIPLE_SAME_RACE_CLASH.description: Multiples containing clashed runners from the same race are split into lower accumulators/singles across clashed runners.

STATE_SLIP_UNINSTRUCTED_SAME_RACE.description: 2 selections in the same race with no instructions settle as a Straight Forecast.

STATE_SLIP_UNINSTRUCTED_DIFFERENT_RACES.description: Selections across different races with no instructions split equally as Win Singles.

STATE_UNNAMED_UNTIMED_OR_MISTIMED.description: An un-named selection or favourite that is untimed or incorrectly timed is 'on' for the next race at that meeting, unless the time stated relates to another meeting covered by a full race-by-race service, in which case the race time takes precedence.
